phase4.technical_robustness: Original 25% depth rho 0.907; Full 0.993, but Full's robustness comes with stronger confounding
phase4.evidence_grade: MODERATE as continuous RNA covariate; LOW as direct translation measure

validation_evidence.human_phase4_mapping_caveat: Homology-group 1:1 was not globally 1:1; ambiguous symbol links excluded in Phase5. Historical human effects/coverage require re-evaluation.
